notes.title: V131
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where units would step too far into impassable territory
[*] Adjustments to missions 2, 5 and 7
[/list]

notes.title: V130.2
notes.notes:
[h2]Added new buttons next to the minimap![/h2]
[list]
[*] Focus King
[*] Select All Army (F2)
[*] Select All Spawners (F3)
[*] Open Menu (F10)
[/list]The buttons for F2/F3 also show the respective amount of available units.

[h2]Further improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated to SDL3
[*] Should more reliably catch certain GPU errors
[*] Can now change mouse confinement setting while the game is running
[/list]

notes.title: V130.1
notes.notes: There are now extended tool-tips explaining attributes. Mouse over upgrade buildings or attributes to get an explanation. Items carried by King / Envoy may also me moused over, to inspect their stats while they are being transported.

notes.title: V130 - CLOUDY
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a visibility calculation bug
[*] Hostile units no longer cast fog of war behind them
[*] Air units can once again not look inside Clouds
[*] Added Coven to Missions 1 and 2
[/list]

notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.notes:
Fix two panics:
[list]
[*] "argument of integer logarithm must be positive"
[*] "Uniform::new called with `low >= high`"
[/list]

Also fix issues in missions 3 and 10.

notes.title: HyperCoven is Released!
notes.notes: [p]After 128 alpha/beta versions, that could be played on itch, or, recently also in the Demo version on Steam, Hypercoven is now released![/p][p]The release is not marked as Early Access – the game is quite robust and easily has enough hours of content in it to satisfy the 3 bucks price tag.[/p][p]Nonetheless, if there is sustained interest in Hypercoven, I hope to keep improving it.[/p][p][/p][h3]Notable changes since June Next Fest appearance[/h3][list][*][p]Campaign flow and gameplay largely reworked, Story added[/p][/*][*][p]4 additional missions, for a grand campaign length of 10 missions[/p][/*][*][p]A small optional tutorial was also added[/p][/*][*][p]Control / unit limit mechanic reworked, it is now a stat that can also be found on items[/p][/*][*][p]The King may now create additional Spawning Circles![/p][/*][*][p]Introducing Coven no. 26, bringing the grand total of different units to over 55![/p][/*][*][p]Minimap pings now appear for events like being under attack, building completed, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Large variety of other tweaks[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]Have fun with the game![/h1]
